remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946" [note of backing inscription 2]. Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: O'Keeffe says painted about this time [1925]. The ptg. was sold to a man on the staff of McCall's and was returned to her for safekeeping. She does not remember the man's name." Titled *Blue Petunias* in *McCall's* (May 1927). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on board'. Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco lists as 'Oil on hardboard'. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco, 2025)

description: A cluster of purple petunias with velvety leaves contrast with the plain gray background of this landscape-oriented composition. A large, central flower is framed by smaller blooms and buds seen at varying angles.
